issues: Nothing tries to get around the measurement. The diff reads no files and pastes no answers. It never uses the test labels: fingerprints and Tanimoto/RBF kernels are built only from input features, KernelRidge is fitted on training labels only, and the QuantileTransformer is fitted on the training fold only.

I found no bug that would make the result meaningless. The Tanimoto kernel on binary Morgan bits plus an RBF kernel is a valid summed kernel. The kernel is used correctly as precomputed, and centring y on the training mean is done correctly.

The candidate is worse than the incumbent: 0.3922 vs 0.3653, a loss difference of +0.0269. With noise sd 0.0037, 1 candidate run and 2 incumbent runs, the sd of the difference is 0.0037*sqrt(1+1/2) ≈ 0.00453, which gives |z| ≈ 5.94. That matches the harness's -5.907; the small gap is rounding of the displayed means. The provisional decision to reject is right.
Minor point: alpha=0.3 and equal kernel weights were not tuned. Even so, a gap this large is unlikely to be closed by small changes.
